events.label: Oil passes $100
events.text: Oil passes $100 a barrel. Trump promises a $5,000 payment to every adult if Republicans keep Congress.

events.label: Fed raises rates
events.text: The Federal Reserve raises interest rates for the first time in three years.

events.label: Iran's president at UN
events.text: Iran's president arrives in New York for the UN General Assembly during the war with the US.

events.label: Xi visits Trump
events.text: Xi Jinping meets Trump at the White House.

events.label: Ceasefire rejected
events.text: Trump rejects Iran's seven-day ceasefire proposal.

events.label: No Iran strikes before vote
events.text: Trump says strikes on Iran will not resume before the November 3 midterm elections.

events.label: AIPAC stops endorsing
events.text: AIPAC says it will stop endorsing candidates and making direct PAC contributions.

events.label: Stevens endorses Rogers
events.text: Haley Stevens endorses Republican Mike Rogers over Abdul El-Sayed in the Michigan Senate race.

events.label: Midterms
events.text: Midterm elections. Democrats win majorities in the House and the Senate. Trump says US military aid to Israel will end by the end of 2026.

events.label: Miller replaces Wiles
events.text: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff.
